Word of God for the Week 15/10/2026
As we remain in Him & His word in us (John 15:7), we are promised - ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you. And because we carry His presence in us, the Christ in us is forever our hope of glory (Col 1:27); as such let’s continue to pray in the name of the One who has promised (John 14:13-14), by asking, seeking & knocking (Matt 7:7-8; Jer 29:12-13; 1 John 5:14-15. Father! In the mighty name of Jesus Christ please continue to show us the way of life, granting us the joy of your presence overflowing with glory & the pleasures of living with you forever amen! Col 1:3-27; Psalm 16:1-11; 1 Tim 1:12-17; Jer. 31:1-40; Isaiah 12:1-6; Luke 11:1-13
